spans.s:
(इ) घषि r. 1st cl. (घंषते)
To render handsome or brilliant.

(आ ऌ,) औघसॢ^1 r. 1st cl. (घसति)
To eat: this root is in many tenses a substitute for अद, and is itself imperfect in others.
(इ,) घसि r. 1st cl. (घंसते)
To sprinkle or drop; this root is not generally admitted.
[1] Correction submitted by Jim Funderburk on 20161130. Reference: https://github.com/sanskrit-lexicon/CORRECTIONS/issues/323, batch 301. note: root with anubandhas.

m. (-सः)
Meadow or pasture grass.
E.
घस to eat, घञ् affix; what is eaten by animals.

m. (-सिः)
Food, victuals.
E.
घस to eat, इन् aff.

m. (-सिः)
Fire or its deity.
E.
घस to devour, and इन Uṇādi aff.

mfn. (-रः-री-रं)
Gluttonous, voracious.
E.
घस to eat, क्भरच् aff.

mfn. (-स्रः-स्रा-स्रं)
Mischievous, hurtful.
m. (-स्रः)
A day.
n. (-स्रं)
Saffron.
E.
घस to eat, and रक् aff.
